verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships AI features (Amplitude AI, an MCP server, an embedded agent), so a buyer can fairly ask whether customer data is used to train AI models. The axis therefore applies, but no evidence shows a documented training opt-out or a no-training commitment. The session-replay masking and consent controls (docs-33) and the shared consent model (docs-16) govern what data gets captured, which is an adjacent control and does not cover AI-training use.
